d: India is looking to enter the next era of fighter aviation as sixth-generation aircraft move towards development. New Delhi has reportedly chosen France’s Future Combat Air System, or FCAS, over the UK-Italy-Japan GCAP, while also developing its own fifth-generation AMCA fighter. FCAS is designed around a crewed fighter working with unmanned remote carriers and a secure combat cloud, with the complete system expected around 2040. The move comes as France and Germany have split over the future of the crewed fighter and China advances its own fifth-generation and sixth-generation programmes.…
